turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! We use am / is / are + verb-ing for actions happening now.
Example: Two children are playing football.

Imagine a park. Exercise: Complete the sentence with the correct form:
A man ___ (walk) his dog under a tree.
